what: hir-ty-mir mir/lower.rs ~1909 panics with "attempt to negate with overflow": the `-<int literal>` shortcut computes `Literal::Int(-value, kind)` with `value: i128`, which overflows for `-170141183460469231731687303715884105728i128` (the literal 2^127 is i128::MIN as stored). rustc gives that literal its value and no error (the negation of i128::MIN as a literal is i128::MIN; `overflowing_literals` only for out-of-range ones). Use `value.wrapping_neg()` (or treat the literal as u128 and negate in the type's width). Hit by blaze-diagnostics tests::lints::bodies::types::limits::type_overflow (rustc's tests/ui/lint/type-overflow.rs), which panics instead of reporting.
